programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries
programme.desc: Cameras follow a conservation team protecting endangered animals in East Africa. It is the end of the dry season at the Lewa Wildlife Conservancy, and the rangers now face the challenge of keeping elephants away from the local villages.

programme.title: Violent Earth
programme.desc: Experts explore the science behind hurricanes as dramatic footage and survivor stories reveal the devastating power of these deadly storms.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: A pride of lions including young cats learning to hunt attacks a buffalo herd, but the raid leaves a cub dead, while three more stray into the territory of a rival pride.

programme.title: Rooted
programme.desc: The incredible story of an 800-year-old baobab tree rooted on the savannah of Malilangwe Game Reserve in southern Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Bec patches up a bitten koala as new vets Ruby and Kerryn soothe a pack of itchy possums. Then, watch rescue officer Dani free a pair of trapped kookaburras.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue
programme.desc: The MMR team helps a lost sea turtle get back home. A huge sea lion is found shot with a crossbow bolt, and Dr Marty helps a fruit bat cope with old age.

programme.title: Kenya Wildlife Diaries

programme.title: Tales from Zambia
programme.desc: A carcass can reveal all about an animal's fate. Here, experts investigate three dead creatures to reveal what led to their deaths.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild
programme.desc: An underwater cave system hidden in the crystal clear waters of Cozumel in the Caribbean.

programme.title: My Best Friend's an Animal
programme.desc: A visit to the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, and a check-in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered.

programme.title: My Best Friend's an Animal
programme.desc: Following Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of penguin Harold Custard, and Barista, who cares for Cindy the baboon.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: Roatan is known for its climate, white sandy beaches and shipwrecks. Here, explore artificial marine habitats at various stages of development.

programme.title: Accidental Wilderness: Europe's Everglades
programme.desc: Documentary about a former wasteland in the middle of Europe where wastewater used to be deposited, which is now a paradise for birds migrating from across the continent and beyond.

programme.title: The Island of Giants
programme.desc: Exploring how whale sharks drive the culture of Santa Maria, the only European hotspot for these giants and why warming seas may be drawing them in.

programme.title: Great Lakes Wild
programme.desc: The amazing world of the flying squirrel, typically found along the shores of Lake Erie, but now moving their territory towards Lake Ontario.

programme.title: Great Lakes Wild
programme.desc: How the elk got a second chance. It went extinct in Ontario, but is now recovering after being re-introduced.

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: A look at some of the Earth's harshest environments, where creatures battle the elements to survive.

programme.title: Osprey
programme.desc: When a veteran pair of osprey return home, they must take on enemies, elements and hundreds of fish if they wish to raise the next generation.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands with Eoin Warner
programme.desc: The wildlife presenter sails a 140-year-old Galway hooker out into the Atlantic to showcase Ireland's western islands. Eoin starts his island voyage on Rathlin, then heads west for Malin Head and Inishtrahull, seeing basking sharks and dolphins, before going south to Achill Island.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands with Eoin Warner
programme.desc: Eoin visits a native woodland on Clare Island and as he sails through Connemara's waters, he finds deserted islands home to skylarks and Ireland's only native reptile on the Aran Islands.

programme.title: Ireland's Wild Islands with Eoin Warner
programme.desc: Eoin is back in his Galway hooker and sails to the islands off Co Kerry, before heading south to his home waters off Cork and ending his journey at Fastnet Rock.

programme.title: Flying Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster explores the world of the pterosaur, a flying creature that occupied the skies 200 million years ago. Visiting sites around the world, from the Dorset coast to New Mexico, he explains how the reptiles evolved to defy the forces of gravity, and examines the features of their anatomy that can still be seen in present-day descendents. He also discovers why they became extinct after dominating the skies for millions of years.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Natural History Museum Alive
programme.desc: The broadcaster invites viewers to join him as he takes an after-hours stroll around one of his favourite places, the Natural History Museum. But this is no ordinary tour as some of the many exhibits spring to life as the veteran naturalist strolls along.

programme.title: Africa's Claws and Jaws
programme.desc: Documentary revealing the weapons at the disposal of Africa's predators, who never know where the next meal will come from, but must be prepared to find it.

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: A look at how sharks are more complex and intelligent than generally believed, and not simply mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans.

programme.title: World's Most Toxic Animals
programme.desc: First of two programmes about some of earth's most dangerous creatures, which lurk in the oceans, the forests, swamps and deserts. In Australia, meet the world's most venomous snake, and in nearby oceans, discover the deadly nature of the marine creatures that share these tropical waters.

programme.title: World's Most Toxic Animals
programme.desc: Exploring more of earth's dangerous creatures, beginning in the South American rainforest with the poison-packed golden dart frog, which harbours enough poison to kill 10 men. Plus, a visit to Sydney, Australia, home of the world's most venomous spider.

programme.title: Baby Animals
programme.desc: Even giant animals start out small, and the likes of elephants, gorillas, rhinos and bison have some of the cutest babies in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Baby Animals
programme.desc: Most animals are born defenceless, but under the protection and guidance of their mothers, they soon become masters of their own universes.

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: The vets wrestle an uncooperative turkey vulture onto the X-ray table to reveal a shoulder injury. A baby groundhog is rushed in after a car accident.

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: A mother rabbit cares for an adopted baby, as the staff assesses the little bunny's safety. Can this odd couple stay together?

programme.title: The Wild Wild East
programme.desc: The wildlife of the Maritime Provinces on Canada's eastern shore. The first edition visits Prince Edward Island to explore the family life of the red fox, sly creatures adept at living just on the fringes of society.

programme.title: High Life in the Dead Mountains
programme.desc: A look at the stark karst plateau of caves and dry peaks in Austria's Totes Gebirge, hiding rich ecosystem where wildlife thrives against the odds.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild
programme.desc: In Brazil's Atlantic Forest, southern Muriqui Dora takes her first steps away from her mum Mimi.

programme.title: Loons: A Cry from the Mist
programme.desc: A year in the life of Canada's common loon, examining the perils impacting its population - from global warming and boat traffic to big wakes disturbing its habitat.

programme.title: David Attenborough Meets Obama
programme.desc: Another chance to see Barack Obama's conversation, recorded in May 2015, with renowned naturalist and film-maker David Attenborough. In a twist on usual convention, the then-US president took the role of interviewer, quizzing Attenborough about his thoughts on the future of the planet, their shared passion for nature, and potential ways to protect the environment. Also includes behind-the-scenes footage from Sir David's latest project on the Great Barrier Reef, as well as highlights from throughout the veteran broadcaster's career.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Rise of Animals: Triumph of the Vertebrates
programme.sub-title: From the Seas to the Skies
programme.desc: Part one of two. The naturalist explores the evolution of vertebrates over the past 500 million years, beginning with a look at how remarkable advances allowed primitive fish to make the radical move on to land, and then take to the skies with the advent of flight. He uses fossils of both ancient and living species combined with CGI and film to chart their journey out of the water to populate all corners of the globe.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Rise of Animals: Triumph of the Vertebrates
programme.desc: The naturalist concludes his two-part exploration of the evolution of vertebrates over the past 500 million years by looking at the history of mammals. He traces their journey from humble origins as tiny nocturnal forest-dwellers to their astonishing explosion in diversity and domination of the world following the death of the dinosaurs.

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: Nature's strangest survivors, from air-breathing lungfish and cannibal snails to transparent glass frogs and ingenious spiders that build their own underwater air chambers.

programme.title: Whale with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Steve freedives with whales and dolphins, getting closer than ever before to record rarely seen behaviours from these extraordinary mammals. He also teams up with world-leading scientists to confront the uncomfortable and urgent truths of overfishing and pollution, along the way uncovering how whales and dolphins are adapting to changing oceans in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Whale with Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Steve reveals the ingenious hunting strategies of whales and dolphins, using sound, skill, teamwork and strategy to catch their prey.

programme.title: Jungle of the Ants
programme.desc: Ants have an incredible form of collective intelligence, which has always fascinated people. This documentary offers an immersive micro-dive into the mysteries of an ant colony in the heart of the French Guianese jungle.

programme.title: Qatar: Pearls in the Sand
programme.desc: The desert peninsula of Qatar, exploring its landscape and inhabitants, as well as its transformation from being a centre for pearls, to being known for oil and gas production.

programme.title: Planet Weird

programme.title: The Ocean's Greatest Feast
programme.desc: The sardine run along the east coast of South Africa, a challenging voyage for the fish as they navigate the ocean, barely escaping the hungry predators who depend on them for food.

programme.title: Bugs That Ruled the World
programme.desc: A global investigation into insect declines, exploring their diversity and their critical roles on the planet. Scientists reveal the beauty of bugs, from pollinators to insect assassins to the tiny clean-up crews that purify the planet.

programme.title: Bugs That Ruled the World
programme.desc: Learning how bees, butterflies, moths and other pollinators keep the fields fruitful and exploring what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished.

programme.desc: Observing the natural and human forces that have shaped this area, discovering a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish and a ray that packs quite a punch.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Rescue officers Jo and Chantelle free a tangled-up ibis, and vet Mel cares for a baby koala that took a swan dive.

programme.title: Monkey Life
programme.desc: It's a first for the park with the birth of a baby for red-bellied guenons Nia and Benny. They are believed to be the only ones of their species in captivity anywhere in the world and were rescued from Lebanon.

programme.title: Tales from Zambia
programme.desc: A look at how the hot Luangwa River Valley, the dry Liuwa Plain and the cool Kasanka National Park offer very different habitats for Zambia's incredible wildlife.

programme.title: Great Blue Wild
programme.desc: An exploration of the Mesoamerican Reef, 40 miles north of Honduras - a pristine home for an abundance of amazing marine wildlife and lush vegetation.

programme.title: Into the Wild: India
programme.desc: A look at the country's wildlife, beginning by joining a young gibbon as it forages for food, dodges predators and masters the acrobatics needed for jungle life.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: A sinister alien parasite brings out the web-slinging hero's darker side, filling him with thoughts of revenge on his uncle's murderer, the shape-shifting Sandman. Meanwhile, he must contend with the challenge of his best friend following in his father's villainous footsteps - and a jealous rival developing powers of his own. Superhero sequel, with Tobey Maguire, Kirsten Dunst and James Franco.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
programme.desc: A gifted teenager investigates the secrets hidden in his dead parents' past, leading him to a mysterious corporation and an incident that imbues him with superhuman powers. A personal tragedy drives him to use his new-found abilities to fight crime, and he is soon drawn into a deadly battle against a former colleague of his father, who has undergone a devastating transformation of his own. Superhero adventure reboot, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone and Rhys Ifans.

programme.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: The web-slinging hero battles a powerful new enemy when a downtrodden engineer develops lethal electrical powers, which he unleashes on those he believes have betrayed him. As if that wasn't enough to keep him busy, he faces an even greater threat when he is reunited with an unstable old friend who has been charged with a sinister mission by his dying father, leading to a series of tense confrontations that threaten to change his life for ever. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Andrew Garfield, Emma Stone, Jamie Foxx and Dane DeHaan.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Peter Parker balances life as an ordinary high school student with his superhero alter-ego Spider-Man, while waiting in vain to join his mentor Iron Man on a world-saving mission. Determined to prove he is ready for bigger challenges, he investigates a spree of crimes committed with advanced weapons - leading him into a battle with a ruthless winged enemy on the hunt for priceless technology. Superhero adventure, starring Tom Holland, Michael Keaton and Robert Downey Jr.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson.

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: The plucky sea creature sets out to prove his boss Mr Krabs is innocent of stealing Neptune's crown. However, the missing item has ended up in sinister Shell City, which all sea-dwellers fear and from which few have ever returned. Animated comedy, with the voices of Tom Kenny, Bill Fagerbakke, Clancy Brown and Scarlett Johansson, plus a cameo appearance by David Hasselhoff.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: The cheery sea creature tries to prevent a precious secret formula from falling into the wrong hands - but when it goes missing, the end of the world approaches. SpongeBob and his friends embark on a quest to get it back, which leads to them developing superpowers and venturing onto dry land. Animated comedy, with the voices of Tom Kenny and Antonio Banderas.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob journeys to the ocean's depths to face the Flying Dutchman's ghost, encountering challenges and uncovering marine mysteries. Animation, with the voices of Tom Kenny, Bill Fagerbakke and Mark Hamill.

programme.title: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
programme.desc: Mario and Luigi make a new friend, green dinosaur Yoshi, as they continue their travels through various regions. Princess Peach, ruler of Mushroom Kingdom, and her loyal subject Toad join the Brooklyn-based plumbers on a quest to rescue kidnapped Princess Rosalina from the clutches of Bowser Jr. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy and Brie Larson.

programme.title: Wonder Park
programme.desc: June, a science-loving little girl, and her mother spend hours playing with stuffed animals and other toys, fashioning a world of imagination connected to a fabulous theme park. When June's mom is diagnosed with a life-threatening illness and has to go away for treatment, June finds a real version of her theme park. Animated family adventure, with the voices of Mila Kunis, Jennifer Garner and Kenan Thompson.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Dracula opens a luxury resort for monsters, to provide a refuge from terrified humans. His cosy sanctuary is disrupted when a normal man unwittingly checks in, and the situation is complicated when the unwanted guest takes a liking to the count's daughter. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Dracula is worried that his half-human grandson is not showing any vampiric tendencies, so enlists the help of his fellow monsters in showing the youngster how it is done. The count is shocked to receive an unwelcome visit from his own father, who does not approve of his son's tolerance of humans. Animated comedy, with the voices of Adam Sandler and Andy Samberg.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Count Dracula and company participate in a cruise for sea-loving monsters, unaware that their boat is being commandeered by the monster-hating Van Helsing family. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Inventor Wallace and his canine sidekick Gromit have set up a pest-control service, and are called in to stop rabbits overrunning a garden show. However, the pair are overwhelmed when a destructive giant bunny arrives on the scene, while an interfering aristocrat contrives to make matters worse. Nick Park's Oscar-winning animated adventure, with the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: A mischievous deer tempts Boog, a domesticated grizzly bear with no survival skills, to try life on the wild side. However, with the hunting season in full swing, all the fearful woodland creatures urge Boog to unleash his inner ferocity and drive the gunmen out of the forest. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Martin Lawrence, Ashton Kutcher, Gary Sinise and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Heroic flightless birds Skipper, Kowalski, Private and Rico uncover a plot to take over the world. Needing help to foil the evil scheme, they seek out a secret society of animal agents, led by a heroic wolf. Animated comedy spin-off, with the voices of Benedict Cumberbatch, John Malkovich and Tom McGrath.
